# telnyx_messaging_hosted_number_order (Data Source)

An order to host numbers you own with another carrier on Telnyx for messaging. After creating it, upload the LOA and bill and verify ownership with the hosted number order actions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Resource unique identifier.

### Read-Only

- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Automatically associate the number with this messaging profile ID when the order is complete.
- `phone_numbers` (Set of String) Phone numbers to be used for hosted messaging.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
